Company Description
 People create momentum. Technology changes the world. We engineer the intelligence that makes it possible. We're Nagarro, a global AI-native engineering and transformation company. We build products and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. Intelligence isn't something we adopt. It's something we engineer, starting with teams small enough that your ideas move, not wait. That's where you come in!
 Job Description
 We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join a multidisciplinary team delivering a strategic data transformation initiative in a regulated healthcare environment. The team is migrating a laboratory instrument data warehouse from an on-premises SQL Server environment to AWS, followed by the development of scalable data products on the new cloud platform. The Data Engineer will design, build, test and operate reliable data pipelines and data structures, working closely with the Data Architect, Technical Project Manager, DevOps engineers and data consumers.
 Responsibilities
Develop and maintain data ingestion, transformation and processing pipelines on AWS. 
Support the migration of data and workloads from SQL Server to the target AWS data platform. 
Implement ETL/ELT workflows using services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda and Amazon Redshift. 
Build and maintain data models for analytical workloads, including dimensional models and reusable data structures. 
Work with Apache Iceberg or comparable open table formats within a modern architecture. 
Translate architectural designs and technical requirements into maintainable engineering solutions. 
Perform data profiling, cleansing, reconciliation and validation to ensure migration completeness and data quality. 
Implement automated testing, monitoring, logging and error-handling mechanisms for data pipelines. 
Investigate data issues, performance bottlenecks and pipeline failures, and drive them through resolution. 
Optimize data processing and storage for performance, scalability, maintainability and AWS cost efficiency. 
Contribute to CI/CD practices, technical documentation and the quality documentation required in a regulated environment. 
Collaborate with architects, engineers, dashboard developers and data scientists in an Agile delivery setup. 
 Qualifications
7+ years of experience in data engineering, database development or a comparable software engineering role. 
Strong SQL skills and practical experience with relational databases, preferably SQL Server. 
Experience developing and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines for data warehousing or analytical platforms. 
Practical experience with AWS data services, particularly Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda and Amazon Redshift. 
Good understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, star schemas and data historization. 
Experience with Python or another programming language used for data processing and automation. 
Understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, security and access-control principles. 
Experience with source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation and validation in migration projects. 
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and modern engineering practices. 
Ability to understand technical designs, identify issues and contribute constructively to engineering decisions. 
Experience working in Scrum or another Agile delivery framework. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with proficiency in English.
